build_discrete_solver: build a MixtureDiscreteEulerSolver with a model, probability path, and vocabulary size for discrete flow matching
sample_discrete_values: sample discrete values from a trained model using the MixtureDiscreteEulerSolver with a given step size
sample_with_divergence_free: sample discrete values using the solver with a non-zero divergence-free coefficient for the probability velocity
sample_with_intermediates: sample discrete values and return intermediate time steps by setting return_intermediates to True
review_solver_implementation: review the MixtureDiscreteEulerSolver class and its sample method for CTMC simulation and Euler discretization
